notes: Pricing page shows the Yearly view (Save 20%): each plan's yearly-billed monthly price, the struck 'was' monthly price (= month-to-month price, confirmed on the homepage: '$39/mo on yearly billing, or $49 month to month', Professional '$103/mo yearly or $129 monthly') and the yearly total. All three amounts are listed per plan. Enterprise is custom. Not plans: FraseCMS Free/Basic ($19/mo or $190/yr)/Pro ($99/mo or $990/yr) hosting add-ons, the free Frase Answers widget tier, extra seats ($29/mo) and pay-as-you-go overages. pricing_status is NOT annotated: there is no free plan of the core product (7-day trial only), but free tiers exist for the Answers widget and FraseCMS add-on, so 'paid' vs 'freemium' is ambiguous — product owner to decide. 'Plan, research, and write cluster content in 70+ languages' describes content/SERP locales, not the product UI language; languages left unannotated (a model reporting en/de/fr/es/pt from it is debatable). ChatGPT/Perplexity/Claude/Gemini/Google AI are engines Frase monitors, not integrations (only the MCP-server access is annotated). '4.8/5 · 600+ reviews', 'Thousands of teams' and logos (Shopify, Atlassian next to a testimonial) are not payment proof. No company location, founding year or headcount is stated. Footer 'Affiliate Program' is incidental: core purpose is SEO/GEO content, eligible.
